property_summary: For any caller who is the owner, calling NETM() resets owner to msg.sender and also (in the reference) ensures balances[owner] equals totalDistributed; the mutant that omits crediting the owner's balance can make balances[owner] != totalDistributed after NETM, so the property is that balances[ c.owner() ] == c.totalDistributed() always holds after NETM is called by the owner.
change_summary: Remove the assignment to balances[owner], so NETM only sets owner (to msg.sender) but does not credit the owner's balance.
